# apple_submit_beta_review (Action)

Submits a build to TestFlight App Review, which external testing requires. The build needs an answer to the export compliance question (`apple_set_build_export_compliance`), and only one build of each version can be in review at a time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_submit_beta_review" "latest" {
  config {
    build_id = data.apple_build.latest.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build, e.g. `data.apple_build.latest.id`.
